summary: Hero on a large rounded panel after Maze, MasterClass at Work and T1 Energy: the headline, lead, buttons and up to three proof ticks on the left; on the right 4-6 photos of different sizes set loosely at fixed places, some running past the panel's edges. Each photo sits at its own depth: on arrival they grow in one after another, while the page scrolls they drift at different speeds, and on desktop they lean a few pixels toward the pointer. On phones the photos become one row of mixed sizes under the copy. Needs 4-6 real photos of the office, the work, the city or the team (client photos first; library photos each once), with the subject in the middle of the frame since small photos crop hard.
